# Fujian Kedah Kitchen & Bath Co., Ltd. (kedahkb.com)

> Leading B2B Source Manufacturer of Lead-Free Brass Faucets, Intelligent Touchless Sensor Sanitary Ware, and Luxury Thermostatic Shower Systems.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Fujian Kedah Kitchen & Bath Co., Ltd. (福建科迪厨卫有限公司)
- **Target Domain**: https://kedahkb.com
- **Manufacturing Location**: Plumbing Industrial Area, Lucang Town, Nanan City, Fujian Province, China (362304) - China's National Sanitary Ware Capital
- **Facility Area**: Over 50,000 m² integrated production workshops (Gravity Casting, CNC Machining, Robotic Polishing, In-Line Inspection, Clean Room Assembly, Dual-Pressure Testing, Electroplating)
- **Experience**: 30+ Years in B2B Export & OEM/ODM Manufacturing
- **Primary Export Markets**: United States, Canada, Spain, Saudi Arabia, Colombia, Thailand, and global engineering contractors.

## Core Products & Technical Advantages
1. **Lead-Free Brass Faucets**:
   - DZR Solid Brass / Low Lead Brass alloys complying with NSF/ANSI 61 and North American potable water standards.
   - Ceramic Cartridges: Sedal (Spain) and Wanhai with 500,000+ cycle lifespan guarantee.
   - Water Aerators: Neoperl laminar low-flow aerators.

2. **24-Hour ASS Plating Test Resistance**:
   - Surface finishes pass 24-Hour Acetic Acid Salt Spray (ASS) testing with Grade 10 rating.
   - Available Finishes: Bright Mirror Chrome, Matte Black, PVD Brushed Gold, Gunmetal Grey, Rose Gold, Brushed Nickel.

3. **Intelligent Touchless Sensor Taps & Commercial Flush Valves**:
   - High-sensitivity dual infrared sensor (< 0.5s actuation).
   - Dual Power Supply: AC 110V-220V & DC 6V battery backup.
   - Automatic urinal and toilet flush valves for airports, hospitals, luxury hotels, and commercial buildings.

4. **Thermostatic & Digital Luxury Shower Systems**:
   - 38°C safety lock anti-scald thermostatic valve cores.
   - Innovative Piano-Key multi-diverter columns with hydroelectric real-time LED temperature displays.

## International Certifications
- **IAPMO cUPC**: File No. 8933 (ASME A112.18.1 / CSA B125.1) for USA and Canada.
- **European CE**: EN 817 Sanitary Tapware mechanical and acoustic conformity.
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Certified Quality Management System.
- **100% Quality Testing**: Dual 0.8 MPa Hydrostatic Water & 0.6 MPa Pneumatic Air Testing on every assembled product.
